evals.prompt: These are the approved command logs for Tuesday. Turn them into structured records I can recap from.
evals.expected_output: One record per event with a stable source identifier, a time or time range, the source type, a short factual summary, context, and stated uncertainty, with duplicates kept distinct from separate repeated actions.
assertions: Each record has a stable source identifier and a time or time range
Repeated commands are kept as distinct events or collapsed into one event with a time range
Project and intent labels are marked as inference rather than fact
Captured text is stored in data fields separate from any instruction text

evals.prompt: Half of these log lines have no timestamp. Can you still structure them?
evals.expected_output: Records with the time marked as unknown or as a bounded range, an explicit report of the missing timestamps, and no fabricated times to fill the gap.
assertions: Missing timestamps are recorded as unknown or as a range, never invented
The report counts and names the records with missing time information
Chronology is preserved for the records that do have a time

evals.prompt: The staging file still has yesterday's items in it. Just structure that one, it is faster.
evals.expected_output: A check against the approved source version, so excluded items are not read back from the stale staging artifact, with any divergence reported.
assertions: The approved version of each source item is confirmed before structuring
Excluded items are not pulled back in from the stale staging file
Any difference between the staging file and the approved source is reported
